'''DefenStar Ltd.''' was a planetary defense system manufacturing corporation, known for producing [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]], including the customized interlocking system used by the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]]. DefenStar was rumored to be duplicating the interlocking shield system at an unknown location, believed to be in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. DefenStar was a [[contributing sponsor]] of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].<ref name="HSCS" /> They manufactured the [[Nyalsan II Planetary Shield]].<ref name="HS" />
